nodes.text: Let $K_{t}(r)$ be the complete $t$-partite $t$-uniform hypergraph with $r$ vertices in each class. Is it true that\[\mathrm{ex}_t(n,K_t(r)) \geq n^{t-r^{1-t}-o(1)}\]for all $t,r$?

#1158 : [Va99,3.65] hypergraphs | turan number Erdős [Er64f] proved that\[n^{t-O(r^{1-t})}\leq \mathrm{ex}_t(n,K_t(r)) \ll n^{t-r^{1-t}}.\]This is only known when $t=2$ and $2\leq r\leq 3$.
